classification: exploratory numerical-method diagnostic; not validation or a hardware performance result

method.change: The full-source branch uses the frozen predictor compression C0 = Sp0 + div(U0) and MULES source Su = -C0*alphaP, with the native final phase flux in its all-cell alpha residual observer.
method.shared_case: Corrected flush-at-inlet junction; 299214-cell native10 mesh; upwind momentum; Euler; one alpha corrector and subcycle; alphaApplyPrevCorr=false; 8 outer and 2 pressure correctors; same physical dictionaries and immutable warm checkpoint.

seed.qualification: warm-restart history remains part of this exploratory comparison

default_full_source.terminal_reason: The unchanged pressure-update guard requested writeNow after five settled steps with final-outer max |dp| above 100 Pa and final-to-penultimate ratio at least 0.9. The solver exited normally and the guard captured the complete checkpoint.
default_full_source.predictor_algebraic_residual_caveat: This 07fca run did not log RP or RF-RP. The reported RF is the discrete alpha residual; the Sp-only lag proxy is counterfactual and is not RP.

sp_only_reference.terminal_reason: The same persistent pressure-update guard stopped the run before 0.50 s.

matched_time_comparison.interpretation: The full-source water phase-continuity L1 is about ten times lower at this one near-coincident point. The checkpoint-relative water-inventory difference is 8.2 g out of about 3198 kg. These diagnostics measure different discrete balances; neither establishes greater physical accuracy. The pressure update remains persistent near 1.26 kPa in both branches.

follow_up_audit.single_numerical_delta_from_default_full: alpha.water solver tolerance 1e-8 to 1e-12; relTol stays 0
follow_up_audit.binary_qualifier: Separate read-only RP/RF-RP audit extension; not byte-identical to 07fca. A tiny 120-cell source identity check found the physical fields byte-identical to the prior binary.

limits: This is a warm-fork, provisional-input internal-apparatus numerical diagnostic; it does not establish measured discharge, device performance, or validation.
The default full-source and Sp-only runs both stopped before the declared 0.50 s target under the same pressure-update health rule.
A lower water phase-continuity L1 is not itself proof of better phase-mass conservation or physical accuracy.
The measured full alpha RF is not the predictor linear-system algebraic residual. Actual RP and RF-RP are reserved for the separate tighter-tolerance audit run.
